sections.heading: Registration
sections.text: Wagner students self-register for most coursework throughout their tenure. We offer registration checklists as a step-by-step guide for the registration process.

sections.heading: Specialization Change
sections.text:
Submit the Specialization Change Form to declare a different specialization (MPA-PNP, MPA-Health, and MUP students only).

Please note that any specialization changes must be approved at least two weeks prior to the start of the spring and fall registration.
